About Us:

Wrapbook is the AI platform for production finance. We’re building a system of action that puts finance teams in control of their whole production, from payroll, to spend, to accounting.

Built for feature films, TV, and commercials, Wrapbook is trusted by teams at Netflix, Paramount, Anonymous Content, and more. With backing from Andreessen Horowitz, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Jeffrey Katzenberg's WndrCo, our team of 350+ is using AI to transform how finance teams work and empower them to do more with less.

The Opportunity: Systems & Business Analyst II (Remote - USA / Canada)

You own the space between the business and its systems. You sit inside the team you support, close to the people doing the work, help define how that work should run and then build toward it.

Day to day, you become the expert in how our teams actually operate, then turn that into clear requirements and well-scoped projects mapped to our business goals. From there you either make the light changes yourself or build the fix with your AI partner. You own requirements end to end, and you push back when a request isn't grounded in a real problem or when today's systems can't support it. Most of that build lives in Salesforce now, and over time you'll own more systems beyond it and build more with AI.

You'll report to the Director, AI & Operational Transformation, and pair closely with your function's ops and AI partners. You bring the workflow context and own the requirements and light build, and they bring the AI build. You'll also work closely with the Salesforce Architect & Lead Developer to get your function's needs on the roadmap.

What you'll do

  • Business immersion. You sit in team meetings and learn workflows before anything touches a system.

  • Problem intake. You surface problems early and push back on requests that aren't grounded in a real problem, including from people senior to you.

  • Requirements authorship. You write and own the requirements.

  • Light Salesforce configuration. Reports, dashboards, simple Flows, field updates, and basic config within the published data model.

  • Solutioning with your partners. You and your AI partner decide together whether a fix is a Salesforce change, an automation, or an AI agent. You own the workflow context and requirements, build the light pieces, and partner on the AI-led pieces.

  • Non-Salesforce systems. You own the roadmap and prioritization for your function's tools, like Zoom Contact Center, Calendly, Gong, LeanData, and Zapier.

  • Roadmap visibility. You keep a roadmap of your builds and share it with your function.

  • Systems enablement. You own onboarding, refreshers, and adoption for your function's systems.

What you don't do

  • Build without scoping or take build orders directly from the business.

  • Heavy Salesforce development, core object changes, and integration contracts. These go to the Salesforce Architect & Lead Developer.

  • Cross-functional prioritization.

What great looks like

  • You define scope, requirements, and a clear definition of done for every build.

  • You find the problems worth solving and teams trust you to shape the fix.

  • You and your AI partner ship what neither of you could alone. You set the foundation and process, and they optimize and scale it.

  • You know your function's workflows and available tools well enough to push back and point to a better path.


What you'll have

  • High agency. You decide what needs doing and drive it to shipped without waiting to be told.

  • 5+ years in a business analyst, ops, or systems role, ideally high-volume, with the seniority to hold your ground with senior leaders.

  • Hands-on admin experience building in Sales Cloud or Service Cloud. Salesforce Admin certification preferred.

  • Evidence you build beyond a CRM: an automation, an AI agent, a scripting habit, an integration. You treat Salesforce as one system among several.

  • Strong discovery instincts. You interview stakeholders, observe workflows, and don't take a requirement at face value.

  • You get productive in an unfamiliar system or domain quickly even if there’s no defined map.

  • Real project management. You own timelines, surface risk early, and keep everyone aligned when they all think their thing is top priority.

  • Clear, direct communication. You can tell a senior leader their requirement isn't ready and explain why.

  • You reach for automation and AI first, and you check the output before you trust it.

Why Join Us

At Wrapbook, creativity meets technology — and not just in the product.

In addition to a competitive salary and all the benefits you can expect from a fast-growing technology company, you’ll get access to a team of creative problem solvers and the chance to see your contributions make large impacts. Benefits include:

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off

  • Work from anywhere in Canada and USA

  • Health and Dental benefits

  • Up to $1,500 USD/ $2,025 CAD towards IT set up for your home

  • Up to 2% matching RRSP / 401K

  • Learning and Development opportunities

  • Up to $50 USD/ $67.50 CAD towards Internet/Cell phone service

Our Pledge to Fostering an Inclusive and Safe Workplace:

Wrapbook pledges to be a harassment- and discrimination-free space for everyone, regardless of age, disability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, nationality, neurotype, personal appearance, political affiliation, professional background, race, religion, or sexual identity or orientation.

Apply Now

Have we got your attention? Submit your application today and a member of our Talent team will be in touch with you shortly!
